title: Lush Decor Sealife
text: Lush Decor Sealife. Purchased 2 sets of bunk beds for my grandsons, twins over fulls and thought these quilts would be the perfect accent.  They were a gift that I sent to my daughter in another State, but she reports they are great in quality and the color is vibrant and looks like the photo in the ad. The twins came with 1 Sham.. the Full with 2.  I think these would be good for girls or boys or even me for that matter.  Loved the motif!  I think I will look for some fun sealife pillows to throw on the bottom bunk.  I never hesitate to update my reviews with useful info should it come up.

product_metadata.title: Lush Decor Sealife Fish Ocean Wave Reversible 2 Piece Blue Quilt Bedding Set, Twin
features: Soft, 100% cotton quilt with a polyester fill - perfectly weighted, all season quilt.
Lush Décor Sealife quilt is the ideal ocean, marine life, fish print bedding set for a beach theme decor or beach house.
Bright and unique with fish, reef and colorful ocean floor pattern quilt and a subtle blue and white wave pattern on the reverse side.
2 piece twin quilt set includes a reversible quilt (86 x 68 inches) and one matching sham (20 x 26 inches).
Both quilt and sham are easy to care for and safe to machine wash cold and tumble dry. Spot clean decorative pillows.
description: Let the kid in you come out and dive into the magic world of sea life surrounded with fish, reefs, and colorful ocean floor. Face of the comforter adds fun to the decor with its print details while reverse of the comforter adds serenity with wave pattern in the shades of blue and white. Made from 100% cotton, this set is soft to the hand and has wonderful quilting details.
